resources.string: Check that your TV is connected to the network and your Jellyfin server is running. If you are away from home, check that the server address works from this network. Then try again or choose another server.
The server rejected this sign-in. Check your username and password, or sign in again if your saved login has expired.
The server refused access. Ask the server administrator to check this user’s permissions and remote-access rules. Retrying the same request may not help.
The TV could not establish a trusted secure connection. Check the TV’s date and time and the server’s HTTPS certificate. You can also choose a different configured server address.
The server address did not provide the expected Jellyfin endpoint. Check the address and any reverse-proxy path, or choose another server.
The server or its proxy reported a problem. Wait a moment and try again. If it continues, ask the server administrator to check the server.
The server asked this TV to slow down. Wait before pressing Retry. LumaFin will not keep retrying automatically.
The server’s response could not be used. Try again, or choose another server. Your saved settings have been kept.
Your current account is still active.
